verdict.rationale: There is only indirect evidence of bulk handling. Contacts can be uploaded in unlimited numbers and viewed on the Audience page, and campaigns go out to dynamic segments, but the documented API, MCP and CLI surfaces show single-item operations such as POST /contacts/create and POST /events/send. Missing for 10: documented bulk or batch API endpoints, bulk update/delete across contacts or lists, bulk operations via the CLI or MCP for agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
